stem.en: What does a negative determinant indicate?

label.en: The transformation reverses orientation, as a reflection does
label.et: Teisendus pöörab orientatsiooni ümber, nagu peegeldus

label.en: An arithmetic error, since volume cannot be negative
label.et: Arvutusviga, sest ruumala ei saa olla negatiivne

label.en: That the matrix is entirely made of negative entries
label.et: Et maatriks koosneb tervenisti negatiivsetest elementidest

label.en: That the matrix is rectangular rather than square
label.et: Et maatriks on ristkülikukujuline, mitte ruudukujuline
